headline: Backlash grows over Trump diesel import plan
standfirst: Lawmakers from both parties are criticizing a plan to import diesel from Russia.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Former President Trump is facing criticism for a plan to import diesel fuel from Russia.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The deal was announced just weeks before the US midterm elections.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The proposal has united both Republican and Democratic lawmakers in opposition.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Whether the political pressure forces a change in these import plans.

caption:
Trump faces bipartisan criticism over plans to import diesel from Russia.

This deal is drawing heat from across the political aisle. Lawmakers are questioning the timing of the announcement so close to the midterm elections. We are tracking how this develops.
